Covers the CLTV-at-or-below-70% exemption, which is one part of the left job; it does not address the other applicability criteria or confirmation case.
Covers only the No Ratio DSCR slice by stating that rent loss insurance is evaluated for those files; it does not determine applicability using the left job’s full criteria.

left.skill: Verify six months of rent loss insurance when required, or the permitted reserves substitution for coverage that cannot be obtained.

matches.note: Covers the rehabilitation-following-casualty definition of rent loss coverage, but not the six-month amount or reserves substitution.
Covers the reserves substitution branch, but not the six-month insurance coverage requirement or coverage definition.
Covers the six-month coverage requirement for the stated trigger conditions, but not the coverage definition or reserves substitution.
Includes the rent-loss reserves substitution, but also aggregates other reserve triggers and does not verify the insurance coverage branch.
States that No Ratio DSCR files remain subject to rent loss insurance, but does not verify coverage amounts or the reserves substitution.

left.skill: Apply the HELOC CLTV basis rule when subordinate/secondary financing is allowable.

matches.note: Same HELOC CLTV basis rule, with the same condition that subordinate/secondary financing is allowable.

left.skill: Apply the listed-property prohibition on subordinate financing.

matches.note: The subordinate-financing prohibition applies when the property is listed for sale; the right candidate limits the trigger to a listing within the preceding six months.

left.skill: For a borrower qualifying with subject-property actual or market cashflow under a business purpose transaction, verify the required executed attestation.

matches.note: Shares the attestation requirement for a borrower qualifying on subject-property actual or market cashflow under a business-purpose transaction, but adds a broader business-purpose classification gate and requires execution by every borrower and guarantor.

left.skill: Verify the requested product and, for an ARM, the published index, caps, and FICO-based margin.

matches.note: Covers the eligible product-type list, but not the left job’s ARM index, caps, or FICO-based margin requirements.
Covers the ARM index, caps, and FICO-based margin, but not the left job’s eligible product-type list.

left.skill: Check each published DSCR condition that applies to first-time homebuyers.

matches.note: Covers the first-time-homebuyer terms but omits the left job’s minimum DSCR requirement of 1.150.
Covers only the first-time-homebuyer full-amortization/no-interest-only condition from the left job’s package.
Covers only the first-time-homebuyer impound condition from the left job’s package.

left.skill: Verify whether the application meets Acra’s stated definition of a first-time homebuyer.

matches.note: Both require every applicant to have never previously owned real property.

left.skill: Check the additional published maximum CLTV and loan-amount requirements for Interest Only 10 Yr / 40 Year Term.

matches.note: Both require the 10-Year / 40-Year Interest Only product to have CLTV no greater than 80% and a loan amount no greater than $3,000,000. Candidate 1 also adds minimum loan amount and FICO requirements.

left.skill: Check the published minimum loan amount and credit score for an interest-only loan.

matches.note: Covers the same $250,000 loan-amount and 640 FICO minimums, but only for the specified 5-year interest-only products, a narrower scope than the left job’s interest-only loans generally.

Covers the same $250,000 loan-amount and 640 FICO minimums, but only for the specified 10-year/40-year interest-only product, a narrower scope than the left job’s interest-only loans generally; it also adds LTV/CLTV and maximum-loan-amount requirements.
Includes the 640 FICO floor for interest-only loans, but does not check the left job’s $250,000 minimum loan amount and also determines the highest applicable FICO floor across multiple features.

left.skill: Check whether the stated first-time-homebuyer, vacant-refinance, and listed-for-sale exclusions apply to an interest-only loan.

matches.note: The listing condition differs: LEFT applies to any property listed for sale, with no stated time limit; RIGHT applies only if the property was listed within the preceding six months.
It determines first-time-homebuyer status, which is one input to the LEFT requirement, but does not assess the interest-only exclusions or the vacant-refinance and listing conditions.

left.skill: Review the application and property evidence to determine whether the subject property meets the program’s investment-occupancy requirement.

matches.note: Both require a non-owner-occupied investment property that is a one- to four-unit dwelling or a condo/PUD unit leased and occupied as a principal year-round residence by someone other than the owner.

left.skill: Check the stated minimum DSCR for loan amounts above $2,000,000.

matches.note: Both require a DSCR of at least 1.0 when the loan amount exceeds $2,000,000.
It includes the left requirement—1.0 for loan amounts over $2,000,000—but also sets minimums for other situations and uses the highest applicable minimum.

left.skill: Compare the requested loan amount with the published program minimum, maximum, and increment.

matches.note: The amount range is $100,000–$3,000,000 inclusive and the amount must be in $50 increments, matching the left requirement.

left.skill: Apply the additional maximum-CLTV requirement for loan amounts below $200,000.

matches.note: Both apply CLTV caps of 80% for purchase and 75% for rate-and-term or cash-out refinance when the loan amount is below $200,000.

left.skill: Apply the published CLTV matrix cap for the applicable loan tier, score, and transaction type.

matches.note: Covers only the $2,000,001–$3,000,000 investment-property DSCR tier of the broader matrix-cap requirement.
Covers only the $1,500,001–$2,000,000 investment-property DSCR tier of the broader matrix-cap requirement.
Covers only the $1,500,000-or-less investment-property DSCR tier of the broader matrix-cap requirement.
Covers only the below-600 FICO case for loans of $1,500,000 or less, where no matrix row is published.

left.skill: Apply the published loan-amount-tier minimum-FICO matrix to the loan request.

matches.note: Covers only the ≤$1,500,000 tier’s below-600 case, which is part of the left requirement to apply the matrix across all tiers and transaction types.
Includes loan-amount-tier minimum-FICO floors but also combines them with other feature-specific floors; it does not apply the left requirement’s full matrix by tier and transaction type.

left.skill: Compare the proposed prepayment penalty structure with the structures printed in the program requirements.

matches.note: Both require the proposed prepayment penalty structure to match one of the same published options, with the same terms and percentages.

only_right.skill: Validates that a property listed for sale within six months is not in default or delinquent on any lien and, for investment properties, is tenant occupied and not vacant.

Confirms that when a guarantor's personal guarantee is executed by an attorney in fact, a Power of Attorney document naming that attorney in fact for this purpose is on file, separate from any entity-authorization consent.

Confirms a corporation's ownership is evidenced by shareholder certificates or the stock ledger accounting for all outstanding shares (with an Affidavit of Lost Stock Certificate where certificates are unavailable), and that an S-corporation or partnership lacking both uses the most recent K-1s for 20%+ owners plus a CPA / tax-preparer letter affirming current ownership.

Confirms that the entity borrower's Operating Agreement (LLCs and Partnerships) or Bylaws (corporations), with all referenced exhibits and amendments, is on file and states management structure, borrowing authorization, and designated signers.

Confirms that documentation evidencing every LLC or Partnership owner's identity and ownership interest is on file, either within the Operating Agreement or via membership interest certificates consistent with it.

Confirms the prepayment penalty treatment complies with the state-specific restriction printed for the subject property's state (AK, IL, KS, MD, MI, MN, MS, NJ, NM, OH, PA, RI, VA, VT), applying each state's borrower-type, loan-amount, rate, unit-count and transaction conditions, with BUY-OUT meaning pending Acra's confirmation.
Flags a borrower whose forbearance was taken within the last six months for case-by-case underwriting review rather than automatic application of the standard seasoning CLTV tiers.

Determines the decisioning credit score for the file, recording the convention applied (middle of three, lower of two, actual single score capped at 700) and the guarantor whose score is used for an entity borrower, since the Standard Summary does not state the rule.

Identifies every party whose credit must be evaluated on an entity-borrower loan — each individual with 20% or greater direct or indirect ownership who executes the recourse guarantee — and confirms the tradeline, housing-history, credit-event and FICO requirements are tested for each such guarantor, not only the guarantor supplying the decisioning score.
Confirms the borrower's credit scores and tradelines are reported under the same tax identification number declared on the application, whether SSN or ITIN.

Determines the maximum allowable CLTV for an ITIN borrower by matching the representative FICO score to Acra's three ITIN tiers and comparing computed CLTV against the matrix maximum for the transaction purpose.

Verifies an ITIN-holding borrower is eligible under the Foreign National Program only when they reside outside of the U.S., distinguishing this residency-based eligibility path from the domestic ITIN tier.
Confirms that borrowers purchasing or refinancing a one- to four-family investment property execute the One- to Four-Family Rider with the loan documents.

Confirms the transaction is classified into the correct matrix column — Purchase, Rate and Term, or Cash-Out — so that the applicable CLTV, FICO, and reserve conditions tied to that column are applied.
Confirms that no debt-to-income ratio is calculated for DSCR-qualified borrowers and that income/employment documentation is not required to support the underwriting decision.

Confirms that only the subject property, the borrower's principal residence, and any second home are listed on the application or Schedule of Real Estate Owned, consistent with the program's limited REO reporting scope.

Verifies cash-in-hand on a cash-out refinance does not exceed the matrix footnote caps — $1,000,000 for loans of $1,500,000 or more and $500,000 for loans below $1,500,000 when LTV exceeds 65% — with unlimited cash-in-hand when LTV is 65% or less, flagging the LTV/CLTV basis and footnote-scope questions.
Validates that a delayed-financing transaction does not exceed Acra's matrix footnote cap of $1,500,000 in base loan amount.

Verifies the Interest Only payment is calculated as the amount sufficient to pay accrued interest monthly at origination, with the Note recasting to a fully amortized payment for the remaining term after the interest-only period.
